name: Volume Painting
aliases: Non-photorealistic volume rendering with brush strokes
definition: A non-photorealistic volume rendering technique that visualizes volume datasets with artistic brush-strokes controlled by user-defined directional texture maps, using volume ray casting to determine surface intersections and Perlin noise for stroke texture.
summary: Volume Painting is a non-photorealistic rendering technique that generates artistic brush-stroke effects by combining volumetric ray casting with user-defined directional texture maps.
